# omniddi_dhcp_host_reservation (Resource)

A DHCP host reservation: a fixed address, optionally bound to a MAC address or DUID. Changes may need approval in OmniDDI; see `approval_mode`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "omniddi_dhcp_host_reservation" "printer" {
  name            = "printer-01"
  ip_address      = "10.20.0.50"
  identifier_type = "Mac Address"
  identifier      = "aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:01"
  description     = "Front desk printer"
  approval_mode   = "wait"

  options = [
    { code = 15, data = "example.test" },
  ]

  tags = {
    owner = "netops"
  }
}

resource "omniddi_dhcp_host_reservation" "server_v6" {
  name            = "app-server-v6"
  ip_address      = "2001:db8:20::50"
  identifier_type = "DUID"
  identifier      = "00:01:00:01:2c:4d:5e:6f:aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:02"
  description     = "DHCPv6 reservation bound to the client DUID"
}

resource "omniddi_dhcp_host_reservation" "ip_only" {
  name       = "reserved-gateway"
  ip_address = "10.20.0.1"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `ip_address` (String) Reserved IPv4 or IPv6 address. It must lie inside the reservation's subnet; to move a reservation to another subnet, set `subnet_id` (which replaces the reservation). Before creating or moving a reservation, the provider checks that no other reservation holds the address and names the one that does.
- `name` (String) Reservation (host) name. OmniDDI requires it to be unique across all reservations.

### Optional

- `approval_mode` (String) How to behave when OmniDDI requires change approval: `fail` returns an error carrying the request id, `wait` waits until the request is applied. Defaults to the provider `approval_mode`.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `identifier` (String) Client identifier: a MAC address (`aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff`) or DUID (hex, colons allowed). OmniDDI stores MAC addresses in lower case with `:` separators.
- `identifier_type` (String) Type of `identifier`: `Mac Address` or `DUID`. Leave both unset to reserve the address in IPAM only, until the client identifier is known.
- `options` (Attributes List) DHCP options handed to this host. OmniDDI does not return reservation options on read, so drift in them is not detected and an imported reservation shows them as unset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--options))
- `subnet_id` (Number) ID of the subnet (IPAM node) holding the reservation. When omitted OmniDDI resolves it from `ip_address`. Changing it replaces the reservation.
- `tags` (Map of String) Single-valued OmniDDI tags. Tag definitions must already exist. Merged with provider `default_tags`.
- `tags_list` (Map of List of String) Multi-valued (list) OmniDDI tags. Tag definitions must already exist.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The OmniDDI numeric identifier.
- `is_dhcp6` (Boolean) Whether the reservation is for DHCPv6.
- `server_group_id` (Number) ID of the DHCP server group serving the reservation's subnet.
- `subnet_cidr` (String) CIDR of the DHCP subnet holding the reservation. Unset when the subnet is IPAM-only.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) All single-valued tags on the object, including those inherited from provider `default_tags`.

<a id="nestedatt--options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options`

Required:

- `code` (Number) DHCP option code.
- `data` (String) Option value, in the option's data format.

Optional:

- `csv_format` (Boolean) Whether `data` is comma-separated values.
- `data_type` (String) Option data type, for example `ipv4-address`.
- `name` (String) Option name, for example `routers`.
- `space` (String) Option space, for example `dhcp4` or `dhcp6`.

- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import omniddi_dhcp_host_reservation.printer 42
terraform import omniddi_dhcp_host_reservation.printer 10.20.0.0/24/printer-01
```
